What will you do
As a warehouse employee, you will work in a glass factory. Here, glasses are continuously produced 24 hours a day, 7 days a week! ✨ There are ovens that produce the glasses. Super fun to see! The produced glasses are transported on a production line. As a warehouse employee, you stand at the assembly line where you pick up the glasses and place them in boxes. 📦 You then place these boxes on pallets. After this, the boxes are picked up by your colleague on the forklift. This way, the glasses can be sent to IKEA on time. This makes customers happy! 😃
